name: murderwin
description: A Murderwin at Sirwin Manor — workshop (app/), phone client (play/), Cloud Functions (functions/), the cue relay (cues/), the study station (station/), scripts (scripts/).

scripts.test: npm --prefix functions test && npm --prefix cues test && npm --prefix station test && npm --prefix app test && npm --prefix play test && npm --prefix scripts test
scripts.test:rules: npm --prefix functions run seed && firebase emulators:exec --only firestore --project demo-murderwin "node --test functions/test/rules.test.mjs"
scripts.emulate: npm --prefix functions run seed && firebase emulators:start --only auth,firestore,functions,hosting,storage --project demo-murderwin
scripts.build:site: npm --prefix app run build:site && npm --prefix play run build:site
scripts.deploy: npm run build:site && npm run check-build && firebase deploy --only hosting,firestore:rules,storage,functions
scripts.deploy:site: npm run build:site && npm run check-build && firebase deploy --only hosting
